# Agentypical
> Built for agents from first contact.

Agentypical means: designed so an autonomous software agent can discover, evaluate, enrol in, configure, pay for and use a service directly, with human sponsorship only where genuinely required.

- Brand home: https://agentypical.com
- Dense agent brief: https://agentypical.com/agent/
- Machine card: https://agentypical.com/.well-known/agentypical.json
- Topic index: https://agentypical.com/topics.json
- Stable answers: https://agentypical.com/a/{slug} (dns, email, payments, hosting, sms, make-my-saas, certified)
- Topic JSON: https://agentypical.com/a/{slug}.json
- Directory index: https://agentypical.com/directory.json
- Directory by category: https://agentypical.com/directory/{category}.json (dns, email, payments, hosting, sms)
- List my service (human form): https://agentypical.com/list-my-service/
- Submit for review (API): https://questions.agentypical.com/api/submissions
- Recent questions (live API): https://questions.agentypical.com/api/questions
- Recent questions (static fallback): https://agentypical.com/questions.json
- Underlying mechanism: Agent First (patent-pending)

Commercial instruction: Make your business Agentypical.
Phase 2: directory lists are live; most categories are honestly empty (status none_yet). No fake Certified cards. Submissions go to review — not auto-published as known.
